notes: Prototype presentation only, no game-rule effect. The backdrop is drawn behind a portrait's transparent characterImage.

Designer decision (2026-10-09): the backdrop follows the character's Department (byDepartment; noDepartment until one is chosen), and the player may pick another on Finishing Touches (Portrait). identity.backdrop is null while it follows the department, or { id, name } once the player picks a different one; stepping back to the department's own backdrop returns to following it. A saved id that is no longer listed also follows the department.

Starship Bridge is designer art (256 x 320). The others are placeholders (scripts/makePortraitBackdrops.mjs, 480 x 600). Every backdrop is scaled to the portrait's size when composited. Replace a file to swap the art; the id is the file name. Alien Interior is not tied to a department: it is only a manual pick.
